stories.title: Death toll from Israeli attacks on Lebanon exceeds 4,350 — health ministry
article_sentences: The Lebanese health ministry has updated data on casualties from the Israel-Hezbollah standoff.

"The overall death toll among the Lebanese since the outbreak of the ongoing armed escalation on March 2 has climbed to 4,353, with 12,323 people being injured," it said in a statement posted on its X page.
According to the ministry, on Tuesday, Israel delivered airstrikes on a number of settlements in violation of the June 19 ceasefire.
No data on potential casualties from Tuesday’s attacks are immediately available.
The ministry said earlier that Israeli troops had used phosphorus munitions to shell the hills of Ali al-Taher, where units of the Shiite movement Hezbollah were active.
Fires broke out in several locations.

stories.title: Child sex abuse scandals loom over France as pupils head back to school
stories.summary: In France, children headed back to school on September 1. But this year, parents had more to worry about than packing backpacks and getting them there on time. Several months ago, news broke of hundreds of sexual assault and rape allegations against monitors at schools and childcare centres in Paris. Monitors are employed by local authorities for after-school care and also look after the children before classes begin and during breaks. Parents want the government to provide safety guarantees.

stories.title: Russian army liberates 1,000 square kilometers of territory over summer, expert says
stories.summary: Andrey Marochko recalled that Russian troops took control of approximately 90 communities over the summer
article_sentences: Russian forces took control of approximately 1,000 square kilometers of territory in the special operation zone over the summer, almost twice as much as in the spring, according to military expert Andrey Marochko.
He recalled that Russian troops took control of approximately 90 communities over the summer: 20 in June, 31 in July, and 39 in August – 32 more than in the spring.
"Regarding advances in the occupied territories, it's very difficult to calculate.
The Russian Defense Ministry doesn't provide such figures, and monitoring data for the summer varies significantly.

But if you compare the spring and summer maps, then, according to my calculations, the Russian Armed Forces liberated almost twice as much territory – about 1,000 square kilometers came under our control over the summer," he said during a live broadcast on his VKontakte page, analyzing the Russian Defense Ministry’ data.
Marochko clarified that the largest number of settlements – 28 – were liberated during the summer by the Battlegroup North.

stories.title: Macquarie University swaps in-person psychology classes with AI chatbot for two subjects
stories.summary: University’s move is part of trend that critics within academia say will lead to further staff cuts and the loss of ‘everything that makes the job worth doing’ An Australian university has swapped in-person classes with an AI chatbot, online quizzes and optional online tutorials in two subjects as institutions give the technology more teaching responsibilities. Macquarie University’s “Virtual Peer” is part of each week’s learning in two mandatory Psychology units, programmed to ask students questions and guide them through scenario-based exercises.
